refresh_policy.website_task_rule: create one fresh independent website task for one refresh goal; never reuse a completed task
refresh_policy.publication_boundary: source project publication completes first; website refresh is a separate post-publication task and cannot block or roll back the source transaction
refresh_policy.task_creation_threshold: create a website task only when the source owner confirms a material displayed fact or explanation would become wrong; path matches alone are candidates
refresh_policy.small_change_policy: do not create an asynchronous task for formatting, refactors, timestamps, hash-only drift, blocked candidates already shown accurately, or other changes that do not alter a user decision

semantic_review_required_when: a module responsibility or boundary changes
a Skill is added, removed, retired, renamed, or changes its trigger, flow, boundary, dependency, failure, or maturity
a displayed validation result changes interpretation rather than only timestamp
snapshot_only_when: generation, hash, commit, observation time, candidate state, production state, or validation count changes without semantic change
ignore_when: comments, formatting, refactors, or tests change without changing a displayed fact
an internal file outside impact_sources changes
a temporary or blocked candidate exists but the website already states the exact candidate status and no displayed explanation changes
only a timestamp, source commit, generation hash, formatting, comment, or implementation detail changed and the last published page remains a truthful historical snapshot
